fields.summary: Pelican Point Terminals LLC accepts claims for losses caused by the diesel release, including lost income from the fishing closure, property damage and loss of use of the public boat ramp. Filing a claim costs nothing.
howTo: Call the claims line or visit the claims center at 40 Causeway Road, open 0900 to 1700.
Bring photos, receipts, trip tickets or tax records that show the loss.
Keep a log of the dates you were not able to work or use your property.
Do not clean oil from property yourself; report it to the claims line first.
fields.nextStep: A claim is first presented to the responsible party. If it is denied or not settled within 90 days, you may present it to the federal Oil Spill Liability Trust Fund through the National Pollution Funds Center.
